resources.string: A thin pill sits on one edge of your screen. Swipe it to reveal a translucent search bar over whatever app you are in. Launch apps, look up words offline, do maths, convert units, or search the web.
Offline dictionary: Princeton WordNet® 3.0 — Copyright 2006 Princeton University. Used under the WordNet license; see WORDNET_LICENSE.txt.

Tips
• Swipe up/down on either edge pill to open the search bar.
• Type an app name, then tap a result (or press the search key to open the first match).
• Tap outside the panel or press Back to close it.
• Stop the service from here when you are done testing.
